text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(Damn it... No matter how much I run, the 
fog in my head won't clear...!)

text_block_list.name: Cornrow Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-san...!? Are you feeling under the 
weather by any chance—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ha, it's nothing. It went away right away.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, don't you have 
preparations for the next one? Go on, 
hurry up.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Oww... Looks like this is gonna keep 
going for a while."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, Jungle Pocket continued 
to be troubled by frequent headaches.
